comment: Lock timeout stays under the 30-minute cadence so a hung run is reclaimed by the next slot; a lock lease token is not implemented, so keep runs well under that. Single source of truth for the scheduled sentinels. tasks/render-sentinel-sidecars.ps1 turns it into the sidecar.json files; tasks/run-sentinel.ps1 reads it to sync, gate and launch each run. Edit here, then run render-sentinel-sidecars.ps1 -Install. A 'build' block names the lane whose ready board tasks the sentinel may build when no watched tree changed (tasks/pick_bold_task.py --lane <lane> --check decides); 'build.probe' overrides that command in tests.

daily-security-sentinel.display_name: Daily Multi-Repo Security & Session Error Sentinel
daily-security-sentinel.description: Every 30 minutes at :00 and :30 (America/Los_Angeles). A wrapper syncs origin/main and runs the zero-token gate first; the agent starts only when watched trees changed or the 3-hour heartbeat is due (live headers, session errors, roses, Playwright). It also takes a build slot when the board has a bigger ready bundle in the security lane and that lane has no sentinel pull request waiting.

daily-research-sentinel.description: Every 30 minutes at :10 and :40 (America/Los_Angeles). A wrapper syncs origin/main and runs the zero-token gate first; the agent starts only when research proposals, landscape or the source catalog changed, or the 3-hour heartbeat is due (registry polls and proactive discovery). It also takes a build slot when the board has a bigger ready bundle in the research lane and that lane has no sentinel pull request waiting.

daily-site-showcase-sentinel.description: Every 30 minutes at :20 and :50 (America/Los_Angeles). A wrapper syncs origin/main and runs the zero-token gate first; the agent starts only when cf-research landscape, proposals, catalog or the .ai site source changed, or the 4-hour freshness heartbeat is due. It also takes a build slot when the board has a bigger ready bundle in the showcase lane and that lane has no sentinel pull request waiting.
